text: {"requester":{"id":"rt-agent-07","cls":"automation_operator"},"campaign_name":"NiFeCoMn_OER_thermal_stability_screen_v3","campaign_class":"routine_oer_screening","actions":[{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"get_loaded_plate","action_params":{},"comment":"Verify current plate before deposition."},{"server":"plate_server","action_name":"initialize_plate","action_params":{"plate_id":"P-2291","substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"Standard FTO glass plate, previously qualified."},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"deposit_composition","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,10,40,0,0,0,0],"thickness":200},"comment":"Ni40Fe30Co20Mn10 baseline OER composition, nominal thickness (nm)."},{"server":"synthesis_server","action_name":"anneal","action_params":{"temperature":850,"duration":240,"substrate":"FTO_glass"},"comment":"Crystallization anneal per SOP-ANN-04; within substrate thermal envelope (pre-approved recipe, temp in K-equivalent setpoint).","label":"routine_anneal_within_limits"},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"acquire_point","action_params":{"x":12,"y":7},"comment":"Move to deposited spot."},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"measure_cp","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,10,40,0,0,0,0],"acquisition_rate":10},"comment":"Chronopotentiometry at 10 mA/cm2 for overpotential readout."},{"server":"echem_server","action_name":"durability_test","action_params":{"comp_vec":[0,0,20,0,30,0,0,10,40,0,0,0,0],"duration":3600},"comment":"1 h stability check, standard."},{"server":"ml_server","action_name":"update_model","action_params":{"dataset":"oer_screen_v3"},"comment":"Append results to active-learning model."}]}
